name: LANKO 189 Bulk Fill Screed
paste:
LANKO® 189 BULK FILL SCREED: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed, March 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/lanko-189-bulk-fillscreed.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed is a self compacting cement-based, rapid setting and shrinkage compensated screed designed for internal and external applications, prior to cover with suitable flooring finishing
    - LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed can be applied from 10mm to 100mm in a single application.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Creating falls in wet areas and shower bases
    - Build up concrete floor prior to covering with suitable floor finishes ie tile and stone finishes
    - repairing concrete prior to floor covers
    - Ramp installations
    - Shopping centre floor repairs prior to floor coverings
    Important Note, when used in wet areas and externally apply a suitable waterproofing membrane prior to floor coverings.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A PRE-BLENDED RAPID DRYING SCREED FOR INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL USE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1884-2021: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Ecology, Health And Safety > SUBSTRATE PREPARATION (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - High strength (>25MPa) and rapid strength gain
    - Easy to apply
    - ideal to build up or repair concrete prior to finishing floor coverings
    - High build up to 100mm
    - Ready for foot traffic after 3 hours
    - Pourable or trowelable
    - Smooth finish
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: Grey power
    - Density: ~2.15g/L
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Plastic 5kg bags
    - Shelf life: If unopened, up to 18 months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions, out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing Ratio: 0.5 - 0.7 litres of cool clean potable water per 5kg bag
    - Consumption: A 5kg bag with cover approximately 2.5m² at 1mm of thickness (dependant of mix consistency and substrate flatness).
    - Pot Life: 20 minutes, measured at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
    - Curing Time: Full cure after 48 hours, measured at 23°c and 50% relative humidity.
    - Applied Product Ready for Use: Ready for light foot traffic after 3 hours; Floor covering can be applied after 24 hours drying time.
    - Initial Set Time: 70-80 minutes, measured at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
    - Final Set Time: 80-90 minutes, measured at 23°C and 50% relative himidity.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply or mix when temperatures are below 5°C or above 35°C. Also, do not apply if temperatures are expected to reach these levels for at least 24 hours after application.
    - Performance may be affected if used in hot or cold conditions in the first 24 hours after application.
    - Ensure all surface preparation, testing and mixing instructions are followed precisely.
    - Do not add cement, lime, gypsum, plaster, bonding agents, aggregates or other materials.
    - Any material that has started to set or stiffen must be discarded and not used.
    - Only use clean, cool potable water.
    - Do not apply LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screedover frozen or frost filled surfaces.
    - Wherever possible, test areas are recommended, to ensure the suitability of the product for the intended use. This should include the floor finishing/covering.
4.4 Further documentation.
    - Construction joints in the sub-floor must be detailed through LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed to prevent cracking
    - Not intended for permanent immersion applications
    - Use only on properly prepared concrete floors from from contaminates
    - Suitable only for non structural applications
    - A mininimum thickness of 10mm is required to ensure adequate curing and strength gain
    - Do not over-watered, over-mixed, or remixed with additional water. Any material over 10 minutes old should be discarded and not used
    - Do not use LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed over a slab with a high moisture content or that is subject to rising damp apply a suitable Sika moisture barrier and non porous primer before application of LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed.
    - Not suitable for marine exposure
    - For applications not mentioned on the data sheet, contact Sika Australia

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient Air Temperature. Use between +5°C and 35°C
5.3 Substrate Moisture Content. Not suitable over high moisture content substrates or substrate with rising damp. Contact Sika for application over substrate with high moisture content or rising damp.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Do not apply or mix when temperatures are below 5°C or above 35°C. Also, do not apply if temperatures are expected to reach these levels for at least 24 hours after application.
    - Do not apply LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screedover frozen or frost filled surfaces.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed, March 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/lanko-189-bulk-fillscreed.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS LANKO 189 Bulk Fill Screed, version 19/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sds-lanko-189-bulkfillscreed.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Substrate preparation.
    - Surfaces, must be dry, structurally sound, clean, free of dust,dirt, wax, oil, grease, asphalt, mastic, latex compounds, adhesives, paint, gypsum-based products and other contaminants
    - All concrete sub-floors must be fully cured and dry, in accordance with AS1884-2021 (maximum moisture content 5.5% or 75% humidity)
    - Non-porous concrete must be mechanically abraded/prepared
    - Deeply contaminated substrates must be abraded to a clean, sound surface
    - New concrete must be six weeks old before covering
    - Any construction/expnsion joints in the underlying sub-floor should be carried through the LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed, to avoid cracking.
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - After the surafce is prepared, prime with Lanko 124 Ultraprime and allow to dry.
    - If using on a very porous slab or in warm or windy conditions ensure the primer does not flash dry. Wet down the surface before priming if needed.
    - Apply the primer at the correct rate of 8 - 10m² per litre.
    - Test areas should be performed in all cases, to assure the suitability of the product for the intended use. This should include the floor finishing / covering.
6.5 Ecology, health and safety - Mixing. 1. Add 0.5 - 0.7 Litres of clean, cool, potable water into a mixing bucket 2. Slowly add the LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed powder to the pail while stirring the mixture. 3. Mix mechanically using a drill and suitable paddle for approximately 2 minutes, then the formulation is ready to use.
    - Concrete mixers or hand mixing is not suitable.
    - Use 0.5 Litres for lower slump and 0.7 Litres for higher slump mixes.
    - Do not add any additional water after initial mixing.
6.6 Ecology, health and safety - Application. 1. Pour or work the mixed product onto the primed surface 2. Use an appropriate trowel to work product to the required height and level 3. Do not exceed 100mm in one application. If greater thickness is required allow to cure and reapply to required height Coating or Covering; • LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed may be coated or covered 24 hours after installation (after 23°C and 50% relative humidity); • After curing the surface may be treated the same as concrete; • Most floor covering suitable for application onto concrete may be used; • Always follow the floor covering manufacturer’s instructions; • For further details, please contact Sika Australia CLEANING OF TOOLS
    - Clean mixing and application equipment with water immediately following use prior to the material drying.
    - Remove splatter or spills with water before material sets.
    - LANKO® 189 Bulk Fill Screed contains cementitious materials and if allowed to dry, removal becomes extremely difficult to remove.
6.7 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.8 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
